tasks.label: vibe: setup
tasks.command: set -euo pipefail; for bin in python3.13 python3.12 python3.11 python3; do if command -v "$bin" >/dev/null 2>&1 && "$bin" -c 'import sys; raise SystemExit(0 if sys.version_info >= (3, 11) else 1)'; then "$bin" -m venv .venv; .venv/bin/python -m pip install -e ".[dev]"; exit 0; fi; done; echo "Python 3.11+ not found. Install python@3.11 or newer (for example with Homebrew)." >&2; exit 1
